programme.title: BBC Proms
programme.sub-title: 2022: Cynthia Erivo: Legendary Voices at the BBC
programme.desc: Multi award-winning star of stage and screen Cynthia Erivo takes the Proms by storm as she sings the great American songbook of the 1950s and 60s. Backed by the BBC Concert Orchestra, she celebrates the legendary female voices that have shown her the way, artists such as Nina Simone, Shirley Bassey, Billie Holiday, Etta James, and Gladys Knight.

programme.title: Travels With Pevsner
programme.desc: Germaine Greer explores the architecture of Warwickshire with Nikolaus Pevsner's 'Buildings of England' as her guide. Visits include Baddesley Clinton Hall and Warwick Castle.

programme.title: Rebuilding Notre Dame
programme.desc: The Cathedral of Notre Dame enters the final stages of its one billion dollar restoration.

programme.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet
programme.desc: Africa, home to the greatest wildlife gatherings on Earth. But even in this land of plenty, wildlife faces huge challenges. At its heart is a vast tropical rainforest full of life. Here young chimpanzees learn how to use tools to make the most of the jungles riches. With knowledge passed down from generation to generation, they can access the best forest foods.

programme.title: The Latest Secrets of the Hieroglyphs
programme.desc: In 1822, Jean-François Champollion became the first person to decipher hieroglyphs in over a thousand years. Now, a new generation of Egyptologists is learning more about the people who wrote them.

programme.title: Call My Bluff
programme.desc: Robert Robinson hosts as Patrick Campbell, Joanna Lumley and Lord Kearton take on Frank Muir, Pauline Yates and Donald Churchill in the game of word definitions and deceptions.

programme.title: Face the Music
programme.desc: Joseph Cooper invites viewers to match their musical wits against guests Annette Page, Richard Baker and Robin Ray. With guest musician Murray Perahia.

programme.title: The Sky at Night
programme.desc: 2022 marks the fiftieth year since an astronaut last stepped on the moon's surface. Taking a look back at the legacy of the Apollo programme and forward to the future of lunar exploration. Maggie and Chris visit the Science Museum in London, where Maggie discovers from space curator Doug Millard that one of the museum's star attractions - Apollo 10's command module - nearly did not make it back to Earth.

programme.title: Horizon
programme.desc: The incredible story of how Pluto has been propelled from an unremarkable ball of ice on the edge of the solar system to a world of unimaginable complexity, where some form of alien life might exist.

programme.title: Art That Made Us
programme.desc: `The Vision of Piers Plowman' and breakthrough works by women like the spirited pilgrim Margery Kempe. Poet laureate Simon Armitage reflects on the poem of loss, `Pearl', as a window into the medieval mind, and artist Sarah Maple shines a light on the subversive Lincoln Cathedral misericords, carved in the wake of plague. Meanwhile, writer Maria Fusco explores how the profound faith of female mystic Julian of Norwich is unshaken by illness.

programme.title: Building Britain's Biggest Nuclear Power Station

programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
programme.desc: Mae Pigyn yn meddwl ei bod yn canu'n swynol ond yr hyn a ddaw allan yw sgrech fel seiren! Beaky thinks she can sing beautifully but what comes out is a siren-like squawk!

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Mae Twt wrth ei fodd yn dysgu am y sêr gan yr Harbwr Feistr. The Harbour Master is teaching Twt about the stars and learns he could use the stars to help find his way at night.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Rhaid i Guto,Lili a Benja achub eu frind Jac Sharp, mae'n ras i roi Jac nôl yn y llyn. Guto,Lili and Benja must rescue Jac sharp and it's a race to return him to the lake.

programme.title: Pentre Papur Pop
programme.desc: Yn antur heddiw mae Mabli yn arch arwr. All hi helpu ei ffrindiau ac achub y dydd? Mabli becomes a superhero! She's going to try and help all her friends and save the day.

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Mae'r arwydd yn y clwb gymnasteg wedi torri, ac mae angen i Harri fynd draw i helpu Cadi i'w drwsio. The sign in the gymnastics club is broken and Harri needs to go over to help Cadi fix it.

programme.title: Caru Canu a Stori
programme.desc: Stori am aderyn sy'n dod o hyd i wy ychwanegol yn ei nyth sydd gan Cari i ni heddiw. Today, Cari has a story about a bird that finds an extra egg in its nest.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Wedi i Peredur Plagus ddwyn pob copi o rifyn newydd Panda Prysur, mae Jetboi a Dan Jerus yn dysgu cydweithio er mwyn ei drechu. Jetboi and Dan Jerus work together to defeat Peredur Plagus.

programme.title: Anifeiliaid Bach y Byd
programme.desc: Dewch ar antur i gwrdd ag anifeiliaid bach y byd, ac y tro hwn byddwn yn dod i nabod crwban y mor a gloyn y llaethlys. This time, we get to know the sea turtle and the milkweed butterfly.

programme.title: Blwi
programme.desc: At a picnic, Bluey and her friends play Shadowlands, but when Coco keeps taking shortcuts, Bluey has to show her that following the rules can make the game more fun.

programme.title: Kim a Cai a Cranc
programme.desc: Ymunwch â Kim a Cai ar antur hudolus a chwareus yn llawn dawns a cherddoriaeth wrth iddynt chwilio am gragen newydd i Cranc. Join Kim and Cai on a playful adventure full of dance and music.

programme.title: Cymylaubychain
programme.desc: Mae Enfys yn hwyr i bopeth heddiw ac yn benderfynol o ddod o hyd i ffordd o gyrraedd llefydd yn gyflymach! Rainbow is late, and is determined to find a way of getting to places quickly.

programme.title: Digbi Draig
programme.desc: Betsi pleads with Abel to let her go to Digbi and apologise to him.

programme.title: Amser Maith Maith Yn Ol
programme.desc: Oes y Tuduriaid a chartre' prysur Teulu'r Bowens yw stori Tadcu heddiw yn `Amser Maith Maith yn ôl'. Does dim wyau yn y cwt ieir ac mae Elen a Siôn yn meddwl am gynullun i ddarganfod ble mae'r wyau yn mynd. Today's story comes from Tudor times and the home of the Bowen family is very busy. Elen and Master Sion come up with a plan that they hope will help understand where all the eggs are disappearing too.

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.desc: There was a time when Wildebeest didn't stampede. They used to stand on the plains and munch grass all day, but there were so many of them and they were eating so much grass that all the animals decide they have to do something about it.

programme.title: Deian a Loli
programme.desc: Mae'r teulu'n mwynhau chwarae gêm o gardiau archarwyr ac er mwyn parhau i chwarae, mae'r efeilliaid yn rhewi eu rhieni! The twins freeze their parents so they can carry on playing cards!

programme.title: Egin Bach
programme.desc: Mae Tera a Nano'n cael hwyl gyda hedyn sycamorwydden, a Septo'n darganfod ei hoffter o gompostio. Tera and Nano have fun with a sycamore seed, and Zepto discovers his love of composting.

programme.title: Yr Whws
programme.desc: Mae'r Whws eisiau adeiladu ffae ond 'dyw'r deunydd maen nhw'n ei ddefnyddio ddim yn gweithio, felly mae'n cadw cwympo'n ddarnau. The Woohoos want to build a den, but then things go wrong!

programme.title: Fferm Fach
programme.desc: Mae Hywel y ffermwr hud yn tywys Leisa ar antur i lan y môr i ddysgu iddi amdan gwymon. Hywel, the magical farmer, takes Leisa on an adventure to the seaside to teach her about seaweed.

programme.title: Blero Yn Mynd I Ocido
programme.desc: Mae'n noson Hwylnos Arbennig Ocido, ond mae rhyw swn yn cadw Blero'n effro. It's the Great Ocido Sleepover, but there's a loud noise keeping Blero awake.

programme.title: Annibendod

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
